sections.title: MID MS/OH VALLEYS TO PA/NY THROUGH THIS EVENING
sections.text: A PRONOUNCED MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE UPPER GREAT LAKES WILL ROTATE EWD OVER ONTARIO/QUEBEC AS AN UPSTREAM WAVE OVER MANITOBA DIGS SEWD TOWARD LOWER MI BY THURSDAY MORNING. AN ASSOCIATED SURFACE COLD FRONT...STRETCHING FROM NRN MO TO NW LOWER MI AS OF 12Z...WILL PROGRESS SEWD ACROSS MO/IL/INDIANA/LOWER MI TODAY...AND THEN CROSS OH AND NRN/WRN PA AND NY OVERNIGHT. A MOIST AIR MASS IS IN PLACE IN ADVANCE OF THE COLD FRONT...WITH BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS OF 68-70 F ACROSS PA/NY...AND 72-75 F ACROSS IL/INDIANA/OH. THE RICH MOISTURE WILL COMBINE WITH DAYTIME HEATING TO RATHER QUICKLY REMOVE CONVECTIVE INHIBITION TODAY IN THE WARM SECTOR. AS SUCH...THE ONGOING CONVECTION ACROSS WRN/NRN IL WILL LIKELY EXPAND EWD IN COVERAGE AND INTENSIFY BY MIDDAY/EARLY AFTERNOON ALONG AND IMMEDIATELY IN ADVANCE OF THE FRONT. THOUGH THE STRONGER DEEP-LAYER FLOW WILL SLIGHTLY LAG THE SURFACE COLD FRONT...THERE WILL BE A SUFFICIENT COMBINATION OF BUOYANCY /MLCAPE AOA 3000 J PER KG/ AND VERTICAL SHEAR /EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 25-35 KT/ TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS/LINE SEGMENTS...AND POTENTIALLY SOME SUPERCELL STRUCTURES IN THE ZONE OF STRONGEST VERTICAL SHEAR NEAR THE LOWER GREAT LAKES.

sections.title: CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: A RELATIVELY MOIST UPSLOPE SELY FLOW REGIME IS BECOMING ESTABLISHED ACROSS ERN CO/WRN KS INTO WRN NEB. GIVEN STRONG SURFACE HEATING W-SW OF THE MORNING ELEVATED CONVECTION ACROSS WRN NEB...BENEATH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...MLCAPE WILL INCREASE TO 1500-2500 J/KG AND CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL WEAKEN. WIDELY SCATTERED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED BY MID AFTERNOON FROM THE BLACK HILLS AND LARAMIE RANGE SWD ALONG THE STALLED FRONT INTO ERN CO. NWLY FLOW ALOFT WILL CONTRIBUTE TO EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-45 KT AND HODOGRAPH STRUCTURES FAVORABLE FOR SEWD-MOVING SUPERCELLS THROUGH THIS EVENING...AS SUBTLE SPEED MAXIMA ROTATE AROUND THE NRN PERIPHERY OF THE NM UPPER HIGH. LAPSE RATES/BUOYANCY WILL BE LARGE ENOUGH TO SUGGEST A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL WITH THE SUPERCELLS...IN ADDITION TO THE POSSIBILITY OF DAMAGING GUSTS AND A TORNADO OR TWO. IF BUOYANCY APPEARS TO EVOLVE ON THE HIGH END OF CURRENT EXPECTATIONS...AN INCREASE IN HAIL PROBABILITIES AND THE ADDITION OF A SIGNIFICANT HAIL AREA MAY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED IN LATER UPDATES.

sections.title: NRN AR TO NRN OK THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: A FEW THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON WHERE POCKETS OF STRONG SURFACE HEATING COINCIDE WITH WEAK LOW-LEVEL ASCENT ALONG THE SYNOPTIC COLD FRONT AND/OR REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. DOWNBURSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS...THOUGH THE COVERAGE OF SEVERE WIND EVENTS SHOULD REMAIN RATHER ISOLATED.

sections.title: SE AZ THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: SUBSTANTIAL LOW-MIDLEVEL MOISTURE AND AN ELY FLOW REGIME WILL AGAIN FAVOR DIURNAL DEVELOPMENT OF STORMS OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SE AZ...WITH CONVECTION EXPECTED TO MOVE WWD TO THE LOWER DESERTS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. THE STRONGEST STORMS COULD PRODUCE ISOLATED STRONG/DAMAGING OUTFLOW WINDS. ..THOMPSON/LEITMAN.. 07/10/2013

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER MUCH OF SOUTHERN AZ
sections.text: ...OH VALLEY AND EASTERN GREAT LAKES... AN EXPANSIVE RIDGE REMAINS OVER MUCH OF THE SOUTHERN AND CENTRAL UNITED STATES...WHILE AN UPPER TROUGH MOVES EASTWARD ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES. A LARGE CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING OVER PARTS OF IL/IND. THIS CONVECTION...ALONG WITH NEW STORMS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE AND ALONG A COLD FRONT EXTENDING NORTHEASTWARD INTO SOUTHEAST LOWER MI...WILL SPREAD EASTWARD ACROSS MUCH OF THE OH VALLEY TODAY. A VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS IS IN PLACE WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 70S AND MLCAPE VALUES AS HIGH AS 3000 J/KG. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT THE SEVERE THREAT WILL BE ISOLATED IN NATURE OF IND...BUT WILL BECOME MORE WIDESPREAD AS OUTFLOWS MERGE. DOWNBURST WINDS ARE THE MAIN THREAT...ALTHOUGH LARGE HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE. ACTIVITY MAY REMAIN SEVERE AS FAR EAST AS WESTERN/CENTRAL PA AND WESTERN NY BEFORE WEAKENING AFTER DARK.

sections.title: CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: FULL SUNSHINE IS OCCURRING OVER THE HIGH PLAINS OF SOUTHEAST WY AND EASTERN CO TODAY...WHERE SOUTHEAST LOW LEVEL WINDS HAVE RESULTED IN SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 50S. MODEL SOLUTIONS ARE CONSISTENT IN DEVELOPING ISOLATED SUPERCELL STORMS IN THIS REGION BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON...SPREADING SOUTHEASTWARD INTO WESTERN KS THIS EVENING. FAVORABLE DEEP LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR AND STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL PROMOTE THE RISK OF LARGE HAIL IN THE STORMS...ALONG WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO. HAVE ADDED A 30 PERCENT HAIL AREA TO ACCOUNT FOR HIGHER CONFIDENCE IN STORM COVERAGE.

sections.title: SOUTHERN AZ
sections.text: MODELS ARE BECOMING MORE CONSISTENT IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF SOUTHEAST AZ. GPS PWAT VALUES IN THIS REGION ARE AROUND 1.8 INCHES...AND STRONG HEATING SHOULD OCCUR TODAY. THEREFORE HAVE ADDED A SLIGHT RISK TO MUCH OF SOUTHERN AZ GIVEN FAVORABLE INDICATIONS THAT STORMS MAY BE ABLE TO PERSIST AS STEERING FLOW SPREADS THEM INTO THE LOWER DESERTS. DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT. ..HART/DARROW.. 07/10/2013

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: MCS MAINTENANCE POTENTIAL APPEARS RELATIVELY HIGH FROM SERN WY AND THE NEB PNHDL SOUTH ACROSS THE CO HIGH PLAINS TO WRN KS. A NUMBER OF ISOLD INTENSE UPDRAFTS...AND A LARGER COMPLEX OF STORMS IN CO...HAVE FORMED IN THE FAVORABLY MOIST UPSLOPE FLOW ON THE WRN FLANK OF SFC ANTICYCLONE CENTERED OVER THE MO RIVER VALLEY. WHILE UPPER FORCING TO SUSTAIN DEEP CONVECTION WELL INTO THE NIGHT IS SOMEWHAT INNOCUOUS/SUBTLE...A WEAK DISTURBANCE APPEARS TO BE CRESTING THE MID-LEVEL RIDGE AXIS OVER NERN CO ATTM...AND MAY BE SUSTAINING STORMS IN ERN CO. AIRMASS AND KINEMATIC CHARACTERISTICS DOWNSTREAM FROM THE ONGOING CONVECTION SHOULD REMAIN GENERALLY SUPPORTIVE OF CONTINUED FORWARD PROPAGATION. GREATER CAPE AND SHEAR FOCUSED ALONG AND NORTH OF THE REMNANT FRONTAL SEGMENT EXTENDING FROM SERN CO INTO SWRN KS SHOULD FURTHER CONTRIBUTE TO STORM/MCS PERSISTENCE/ORGANIZATION WITH POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS SPREADING INTO WRN KS THROUGH THE EVENING. MORE ISOLD/DISCRETE STORMS AND SUPERCELLS COULD STILL POSE SOME THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS EVEN A BRIEF TORNADO ACROSS WY/NEB BORDER...AND EVEN INTO WRN SD...FOR A COUPLE MORE HOURS. REFER TO MCD 1376 FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS.

sections.title: CNTRL APPALACHIANS TO NORTHEAST
sections.text: PRE-FRONTAL CONVECTION STRETCHES S-SWWD FROM SRN QUEBEC/NERN NY TO A MORE CONSOLIDATED SQUALL LINE OVER PA AND ALONG THE SPINE OF THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS. THIS ACTIVITY WAS BEING DRIVEN BY A PROGRESSIVE MID-LEVEL SHORT WAVE TROUGH CROSSING THE ERN GREAT LAKES AND ACCOMPANIED BY RELATIVELY STRONG 50-60KT MID-LEVEL FLOW. DESPITE A DECREASE IN SFC-BASED INSTABILITY EXPECTED WITH NOCTURNAL COOLING...FORCING AND SHEAR ASSOCIATED WITH THE ADVANCING TROUGH AND FRONTAL SYSTEM SHOULD SUSTAIN A CHANCE FOR A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS AS DEEP-LAYER ASCENT ACTS ON HIGH PW AIRMASS. GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR A FEW STORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS ISOLD LARGE HAIL WILL EXIST FROM ERN WV PNHDL AND CNTRL PA NEWD INTO ERN NY AND WRN NEW ENGLAND THROUGH TONIGHT.

sections.title: SRN AND CNTRL AZ
sections.text: MODEST 20KT E-SELY FLOW ON THE SRN/SWRN FLANK OF MID-LEVEL ANTICYCLONE WAS LIKELY AIDING IN THE WWD PROPAGATION OF LOOSELY ORGANIZED CONVECTION OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SERN AZ THIS EVENING. STORMS APPEAR TO BE DEVELOPING WITHIN AN INSTABILITY AXIS WHERE MLCAPE IS ON THE ORDER OF 1500 TO 2000 J/KG. OTHER THAN TERRAIN AND THERMODYNAMIC INFLUENCES...FORCING TO SUSTAIN MORE ROBUST STORM/MCS DEVELOPMENT APPEARS AMBIGUOUS ATTM. NONETHELESS...GIVEN CURRENT TRENDS AND THE POTENTIAL FOR STORMS TO CONTINUE TO SPREAD WWD ACROSS HOT LOWER DESERTS...WILL MAINTAIN SLGT RISK IN THE REGION FOR THE EVENING/NIGHTTIME HOURS.

sections.title: MIDDLE TN WEST ACROSS MS VALLEY TO AR/OK
sections.text: CLUSTERS OF STRONG TO ISOLD SEVERE STORMS EXIST AHEAD/ALONG WEAK AND DECAYING COLD FRONT FROM MIDDLE TN WWD TO AR AND THE OK PNHDL THIS EVENING. OTHER THAN COLD POOL DYNAMICS AND CELL/UPDRAFT MERGERS INTERACTING WITH POCKETS OF STRONGER SFC-BASED INSTABILITY...THERE IS LIMITED SUPPORT IN THE FORM OF SHEAR/FORCING IN MOST AREAS FOR MORE ORGANIZED STORMS TO PERSIST. HOWEVER...STORM-SCALE GUIDANCE...INCLUDING 12Z WRF-NMM AND WRF-ARW MODELS...DO SUGGEST THAT CLUSTER OF STORMS CURRENTLY OVER MIDDLE TN MAY HAVE A SOMEWHAT BETTER CHANCE AT PERSISTING AND PERHAPS EVOLVING INTO A SMALL MCS SPREADING S-SWWD ACROSS PARTS OF THE TN VALLEY IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS. DESPITE GENERALLY WEAK DEEP SHEAR/FLOW...THIS POTENTIAL MAY BE SUSTAINED BY MAGNITUDE OF AVAILABLE INSTABILITY AND SUFFICIENT LARGE SCALE ASCENT BRUSHING THE REGION FROM THE SHORT WAVE TROUGH TO THE NORTH. ..CARBIN.. 07/11/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM POTENTIAL INCLUDING HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE INTO LATE MORNING/EARLY AFTERNOON FROM NORTHEAST/EAST-CENTRAL IL INTO NORTHERN/CENTRAL INDIANA AND EVENTUALLY WESTERN OH. WHILE A WATCH ISSUANCE IS NOT IMMINENT...CURRENT THINKING IS THAT A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH COULD BECOME NECESSARY BY LATE MORNING/MIDDAY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED ELEVATED TSTMS HAVE INCREASED EARLY THIS MORNING ACROSS PORTIONS OF CENTRAL/NORTHEAST IL...WITH SOME OF THESE STORMS HAVING STRONGER-TYPE MULTICELL/TRANSIENT SUPERCELLULAR CHARACTERISTICS. THESE STORMS ARE OCCURRING NEAR A SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING COLD FRONT...ON THE NORTHEASTERN FRINGE OF ONGOING STORMS/SURFACE COLD POOL AND POSSIBLE EMBEDDED MCV FROM EAST-CENTRAL MO INTO SOUTHERN IL. THE 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDING FROM LINCOLN IL SAMPLES AROUND 3500 J/KG OF MLCAPE IN THE PRESENCE OF RELATIVELY HIGH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE CONTENT /LOWER TO MIDDLE 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS/ AND NEARLY 7.0 C/KM MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. THIS OBSERVED SOUNDING...AND OTHER REGIONAL DERIVED WIND DATA...SAMPLES THE EAST-SOUTHEAST MOVING MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX ACROSS IL/NORTHERN INDIANA/LOWER MI WITH 35-40 KT WESTERLIES BETWEEN 3-6 KM. ESPECIALLY GIVEN THAT CLOUD BREAKS ARE EVIDENT ACROSS NORTHERN INDIANA/OH IN VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY...THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL QUICKLY HEAT AND BECOME WEAKLY CAPPED AND MODERATE-STRONGLY UNSTABLE...WITH MODIFICATIONS TO 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS SUGGESTING THAT SURFACE BASED STORMS/DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL WILL BECOME MORE PROBABLE AS TEMPERATURES REACH THE MIDDLE 80S F. IN ALL...EXPECTATIONS ARE FOR STORMS TO INCREASE/INTENSIFY ALONG THE COLD FRONT ACROSS PARTS OF IL/INDIANA/OH INTO THIS AFTERNOON...SUCH THAT A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED FOR PORTIONS OF THE REGION FOR A SEVERE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND THREAT VIA ORGANIZED MULTICELLS/LINE SEGMENTS AND POSSIBLY SOME SUPERCELLS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS NRN IND...NW OH AND SRN LOWER MI THIS AFTERNOON. WIND DAMAGE...LARGE HAIL AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO COULD OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER CELLS. WW ISSUANCE WILL BE LIKELY ACROSS THE REGION OVER THE NEXT HOUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWWD FROM SRN LOWER MI INTO NW IND AND NRN IL WITH SFC DEWPOINTS AHEAD OF THE FRONT IN THE LOWER TO MID 70S F. AS TEMPS HAVE WARMED INTO THE MID 80S F...STRONG INSTABILITY HAS DEVELOPED WITH OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWING MLCAPE OF 2000 TO 3000 J/KG FROM DETROIT SWD TO NEAR CINCINNATI. IN ADDITION...A 50 TO 65 KT MID-LEVEL JET MAX IS ANALYZED OVER THE GREAT LAKES REGION. DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS ESTIMATED IN THE 40 TO 50 KT RANGE ACROSS MUCH OF THE MCD AREA SUGGESTING THAT SHEAR WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. IF CELLS CAN REMAIN DISCRETE...THEN SUPERCELLS WILL BE FAVORED WITH A LARGE HAIL...WIND DAMAGE AND POSSIBLY A FEW TORNADOES. IF CELLS CONGEAL INTO A LINE..THEN WIND DAMAGE COULD BECOME THE DOMINANT THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS SRN IND...CNTRL AND WRN KY AND NRN TN. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE AS STORMS MOVE INTO THE AREA FROM THE WEST. WW MAY BECOME NECESSARY LATER THIS AFTERNOON IF ORGANIZATION OCCURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS HAS DEVELOPED ACROSS SRN IND ALONG A COLD FRONT ADVANCING SEWD. AHEAD OF THE FRONT...SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MID 70S AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWS MLCAPE IN THE 3000 TO 3500 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...ANALYSIS SHOWS LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES HAVE STEEPENED TO ABOUT 7.5 C/KM. THIS COULD BE ENOUGH FOR AN ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE AS THE STRONGER CELLS GUST OUT. REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOW WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES WHICH SHOULD KEEP ANY SEVERE THREAT RELATIVELY ISOLATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN AREAL COVERAGE AND INTENSITY ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL ARE POSSIBLE. WW WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED BY 20Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO INCREASED BUOYANCY ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS FROM SERN WY INTO WRN KS. WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES IN PLACE AND CONVECTION DEEPENING OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN THERE IS INCREASING CONFIDENCE THAT TSTMS WILL GRADUALLY MATURE/ORGANIZE AS THEY PROPAGATE ACROSS THE PLAINS. SUBSTANTIAL SELY LOW LEVEL FLOW WITH MUCAPE AOA 2000 J/KG SHOULD BE MORE THAN ADEQUATE FOR ROBUST UPDRAFTS/DOWNDRAFTS. LATEST VIS IMAGERY ALSO SUGGESTS BOUNDARY LAYER CU FIELD IS DEEPENING NEAR THE CO/KS BORDER FROM CHEYENNE COUNTY TO HAMILTON COUNTY ALONG WHAT APPEARS TO BE A WEAK CONFLUENCE ZONE. TSTMS COULD EASILY EVOLVE ALONG THIS CORRIDOR AND SPREAD INTO WRN KS. FOR THIS REASON A FAIRLY LARGE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED TO ACCOUNT FOR THIS DEVELOPING CONVECTION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS ARE POSSIBLE WITH TSTMS ACROSS OK INTO NORTHWEST AR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RENEWED UPDRAFTS ARE FORMING INVOF OLD CONVECTIVE DEBRIS FROM GARFIELD COUNTY...ESEWD TO NEAR THE AR STATE LINE OVER ADAIR COUNTY. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD GRADUALLY INCREASE IN BOTH AREAL COVERAGE AND INTENSITY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS WHICH SHOULD FORCE WEAK SFC BOUNDARY TO SETTLE TOWARD THE I-40 CORRIDOR. WITH TEMPERATURES ON THE ORDER OF 100F AND RELATIVELY DRY SUB-CLOUD LAYER THERE IS SOME CONCERN FOR DAMAGING WINDS. PW VALUES RANGE FROM 1.6-1.9 INCHES WHICH COULD ENHANCE DOWNBURST POTENTIAL...ESPECIALLY IF SINGLE CELL UPDRAFTS COALESCE INTO LARGER CLUSTERS. AT THIS TIME IT APPEARS SEVERE THREAT MAY REMAIN TOO ISOLATED TO WARRANT A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS LIKELY TO DEVELOP ACROSS WRN NY AND WRN-CNTRL PA OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE WILL BE NEEDED SOON ACROSS THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINEAR MCS IS ONGOING FROM NRN OH EXTENDING SWD INTO CNTRL KY JUST AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT MOVING SEWD ACROSS THE REGION. SFC DEWPOINTS AHEAD OF THE FRONT ARE IN THE LOWER TO MID 70S F EXTENDING AS FAR EAST AS WRN PA AND WRN NY. MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED TO BE AROUND 2000 J/KG ALONG THIS CORRIDOR. IN ADDITION...REGIONAL WSR-88 VWPS SHOW 35 TO 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR SUGGESTING THE ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT A SEVERE THREAT. AS LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES STEEPEN FURTHER AHEAD OF THE STORMS APPROACHING FROM THE WEST...WIND DAMAGE WILL BECOME LIKELY WITH THE MORE ORGANIZED LINE SEGMENTS. HAIL COULD ALSO OCCUR WITH THE MORE INTENSE CORES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG WINDS MAY ACCOMPANY CONVECTION ACROSS ERN AZ INTO THE EVENING HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION IS SLOWLY DEEPENING ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN FROM THE MOGOLLON RIM...SWD TO SANTA CRUZ COUNTY NEAR THE MEXICAN BORDER. IN THE WAKE OF EARLY MORNING MCV...ELY COMPONENT IS DEEPER AND STRONGER ACROSS THIS REGION THAN YESTERDAY. FOR THIS REASON IT APPEARS TSTMS THAT EVOLVE MAY BE SLIGHTLY MORE ORGANIZED AND PROPAGATE DEEPER ACROSS LOWER DESERT REGIONS THAN ON MONDAY. GUSTY WINDS SHOULD BE NOTED WITH STRONGER PRECIP CORES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS THE WATCH AREA...WITH THE GREATEST THREAT FROM WRN/CNTRL PA INTO WRN/CNTRL NY THROUGH EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN EXTENSIVE LINE OF STORMS PERSISTS FROM WRN NY/PA SWWD ACROSS THE OH RIVER AND INTO ERN KY/TN. THE AIR MASS AHEAD OF SRN PORTIONS OF THE LINE...FROM ERN KY/TN INTO WV AND WRN VA...HAS STABILIZED A BIT DUE TO CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING AND OUTFLOW SPREADING NWWD. THEREFORE...THESE AREAS E OF WW 407 MAY NOT REQUIRE ANY ADDITIONAL WATCHES THIS EVENING. THE MOST FAVORABLE COMBINATION FOR SEVERE WIND SHOULD BE ACROSS PA/NY AHEAD OF THE CURRENT LINE OF STORMS WHERE THE STRONGEST MEAN FLOW EXISTS CONCURRENT WITH SUFFICIENT MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY. DEEP LAYER SHEAR ACROSS NRN PA AND NY WILL ALSO FAVOR A FEW LONGER LIVED CELLS CAPABLE OF MARGINAL HAIL. ..JEWELL.. 07/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE TSTMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH THIS EVENING...WITH A THREAT OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. CONSIDERABLE UNCERTAINTY REMAINS REGARDING THE COVERAGE OF STORMS...BUT THIS AREA WILL BE MONITORED FOR ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT AND POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS OF 2245Z...AN ISOLATED SEVERE TSTM THAT DEVELOPED OVER THE BLACK HILLS NEAR RAPID CITY HAS WEAKENED. MEANWHILE...THE CU FIELD HAS BEEN INCREASING ACROSS FAR SERN MT TO THE EAST OF A WEAK SFC LOW. PER RECENT MESOANALYSIS...THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE AREA IS CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE MLCAPE OF 1500-2500 J/KG AND SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR /0-6 KM SHEAR OF 35-40 KTS/ FOR STORM ORGANIZATION...WITH SPLITTING SUPERCELLS POSSIBLE. WITH ONLY SUBTLE FORCING FOR ASCENT ACROSS THE REGION...COVERAGE OF STORMS IS LIKELY TO REMAIN ISOLATED...BUT STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AOA 8 C/KM WILL SUPPORT VERY LARGE HAIL /POTENTIALLY NEAR 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER/ WITH ANY SUSTAINED SUPERCELL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE WIND THREAT WILL CONTINUE ACROSS ERN CO INTO WRN KS ALONG AND AHEAD OF A LOOSELY ORGANIZED MCS. MEANWHILE...MORE ISOLATED STORMS ACROSS SERN WY INTO THE NEB PANHANDLE WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT OF SEVERE HAIL/WIND.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DEVELOPMENT OF A LOOSELY ORGANIZED MCS APPEARS TO BE UNDERWAY ACROSS ERN CO AS OF 00Z...WITH NUMEROUS STRONG/SEVERE STORMS ON THE LEADING EDGE OF AN EWD PROPAGATING COLD POOL. WITH MODERATE MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J/KG AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 35-45 KTS IN PLACE PER 00Z DDC SOUNDING AND RECENT MESOANALYSIS...A SEVERE WIND THREAT WILL PERSIST INTO THE ERN PART OF WW 408 ACROSS WRN KS WITH SOME SEVERE HAIL POSSIBLE IN THE STRONGER CORES. NOCTURNAL COOLING/STABILIZATION WILL LIKELY BEGIN TO WEAKEN THIS ACTIVITY AS IT APPROACHES THE ERN EDGE OF THE WATCH...BUT A SMALL DOWNSTREAM WATCH OR LOCAL EXTENSION OF THE WW 408 MAY BECOME NECESSARY LATER THIS EVENING. MEANWHILE...ACTIVITY HAS BEEN MORE ISOLATED ACROSS THE NRN PART OF WW 408 ACROSS SERN WY INTO THE NEB PANHANDLE...BUT A FEW ROBUST CELLS CAPABLE OF SEVERE HAIL/WIND AND PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO WILL LIKELY PERSIST FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT 1-2 HRS. SOME UPSCALE GROWTH AND/OR ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR LATER THIS EVENING WITH A CONTINUED THREAT OF HAIL AS THE LOW-LEVEL JET INCREASES...BUT A GENERAL DOWNWARD TREND IN THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED AFTER 02-03Z AS SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY WANES. ..DEAN.. 07/11/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A BROKEN LINE OF STORMS WILL PERSIST FOR A FEW MORE HOURS ALONG THE COLD FRONT...WITH A MARGINAL SEVERE WIND AND HAIL THREAT. NO NEW WATCHES ARE EXPECTED TO BE NEEDED AS THE THREAT SHOULD BE ISOLATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE STRONGEST STORMS CURRENTLY EXIST ACROSS S CNTRL NY WITH HAIL REPORTED IN CAYUGA COUNTY NY. OTHER ISOLATED CELLS WERE SKIRTING THE CANADIAN BORDER ACROSS FAR NRN NY...WITH WEAKENING ACTIVITY EXTENDING SWD ALONG THE FRONT INTO PA WHERE LIGHTNING STRIKES ARE DWINDLING. WHILE FLOW AND SHEAR ARE STRONGEST ACROSS NY AND NEW ENGLAND...DIURNAL STABILIZATION WILL CONTINUE...AND THE MAIN UPPER SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL ONLY HAVE A GLANCING INFLUENCE OVER MOST OF THE AREA. THE OOZ ALB SOUNDING SHOWED A MOIST PROFILE BUT WITH MARGINAL OVERALL SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS. BUT GIVEN STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR ACROSS NRN NY INTO VT...CELLULAR ACTIVITY WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THERE WITH MAINLY MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. ..JEWELL.. 07/11/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG/POTENTIALLY SEVERE STORMS WILL CONTINUE THROUGH THE EVENING. AT THIS TIME...LIMITED COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO PRECLUDE WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL ISOLATED STRONG/POTENTIALLY SEVERE STORMS ARE ONGOING ACROSS CNTRL/SRN AZ AS OF 0115Z. ACROSS SERN AZ...THE ENVIRONMENT IS CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE INSTABILITY...WHERE VERY WARM SFC TEMPS COMBINED WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID-UPPER 50S ARE SUPPORTING MLCAPE OF 1500-2500 J/KG PER RECENT MESOANALYSIS. MODEST ESELY MIDLEVEL FLOW ATOP WLY SFC WINDS IS RESULTING IN EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 25-35 KTS...WHICH IS SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES. THE EARLIER STRONG CELL ACROSS FAR ERN PINAL COUNTY EXHIBITED OCCASIONAL MIDLEVEL ROTATION IN THIS ENVIRONMENT. RECENT DEVELOPMENT OVER COCHISE COUNTY MAY ALSO EVOLVE INTO ORGANIZED STRUCTURES OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HRS. WET DOWNBURSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER STORMS GIVEN THE POTENTIAL FOR PRECIP LOADING WITH PW VALUES AOA 1.5 INCHES...BUT UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A MORE WIDESPREAD WIND THREAT IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED. FURTHER NORTH ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL AZ...ISOLATED STRONG STORMS ARE ONGOING JUST S OF PRC AND ALSO ACROSS GILA INTO NRN GRAHAM COUNTIES. WHILE EFFECTIVE SHEAR IS WEAKER COMPARED TO AREAS FURTHER SOUTH...MODERATE INSTABILITY AND RELATIVELY HIGH PW VALUES WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR AN ISOLATED SEVERE RISK THROUGH THE EVENING. GIVEN THE ISOLATED NATURE OF THE SEVERE RISK ACROSS THESE AREAS...WW ISSUANCE IS CURRENTLY NOT ANTICIPATED.
